title: Among Us
summary: Among Us is fully playable on Pixel Port's free runtime, Steam sign-in and online lobbies included. It is one of our most-tested titles on Apple Silicon.

steps.title: Install Pixel Port
steps.body: Download Pixel Port and let it set up the free runtime on first launch.

steps.title: Add Among Us
steps.body: Find Among Us in the catalogue and hit Install & Play. Pixel Port fetches it and configures it for your Mac automatically.

steps.title: Play online
steps.body: Launch from your Library and sign in to Steam. Online lobbies work the same as on Windows.

title: Fortnite
summary: Fortnite does not run on Mac through Pixel Port, and the reason is not technical.

blocker.status: Fortnite uses anti-cheat that Epic has chosen not to enable on macOS. Nothing Pixel Port does can change that. This one is genuinely up to Epic, and if they switch Mac support on, it could work overnight.

title: Valorant
summary: Valorant cannot run on Mac through Pixel Port, and it is a policy decision, not a Pixel Port limitation.

blocker.status: Vanguard runs at the kernel level and Riot does not permit it on macOS. No compatibility layer can run Valorant on a Mac today. This is up to Riot.

title: Apex Legends
summary: Apex Legends does not run on Mac through Pixel Port because of its anti-cheat, not its graphics.

blocker.status: Easy Anti-Cheat is not enabled for Mac on Apex Legends. The technology to allow it exists, so this is a decision for EA and Respawn to make.

title: Marvel Rivals
summary: Marvel Rivals cannot run on Mac through Pixel Port yet, and the blocker is its anti-cheat.

blocker.status: Marvel Rivals ships anti-cheat that does not run on macOS. This is up to NetEase. If they enable Mac support, we will test it the same day.

title: The Finals
summary: The Finals does not run on Mac through Pixel Port because of its anti-cheat requirement.

blocker.status: Easy Anti-Cheat is not enabled for Mac on The Finals. This is up to Embark Studios.
